tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning reasons
Bidders should abide to all the Terms and Conditions mentioned in the Bid Document attached
Any statutory taxers will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs 7.18 Lakhs, Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents
BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL RELEVANT TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS AS PERCONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT ATTACHED
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. 2.15 Lakhs
Satisfactorily completed at least one similar works of value not less than Rs. 3.59 lakhs, as prime contractor
Tenderers should furnish GST, ESI and EPF paid challans for the last financial year 2025-26 should be uploaded
The tenderer should have in his/Firm name Registered GST Certificate
The tenderer should have valid PF and ESI Registration
The Tenderer should have valid registration certificate issued by Labour department, Government of Karnataka
